expected: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Browser khong MIME-sniff content-type.

title: SECURITY - zip bomb detection: file nen 1KB expand den 10GB
preconditions: Zip bomb file (neu MIME cho phep zip).
steps: Upload file .zip trong ALLOWED list (hoac .docx co zip bomb ben trong).
expected: Neu .zip khong trong allowed: reject. Neu .docx: unzip check dung; size limit prevent extraction. Khong OOM.

title: SECURITY - Clickjacking prevention: X-Frame-Options header
steps: Kiem tra X-Frame-Options hoac CSP frame-ancestors.
expected: X-Frame-Options: DENY hoac CSP frame-ancestors: 'none'. Phong clickjacking.

title: SECURITY - download file: Content-Type phai match file content
expected: Content-Type: application/pdf (match original MIME). Khong bao gio tra Content-Type: text/html cho binary file.

title: RED - upload khi DB transaction timeout - 500 + file cleanup
expected: Transaction timeout → 500. file bi cleanup. Khong partial state.

title: RED - upload FormData co extra fields (unknown props) - ignore them
expected: BE ignore unknown fields (DTO validation). 201 Accept. Khong luu extra fields vao DB.

title: RED - upload qua API voi Content-Type sai (application/json) - 400
expected: multer: multipart/form-data la bat buoc. 400 hoac 415 Unsupported Media Type.

title: RED - upload voi petitionId la ObjectID format (Mongo) - 400 hoac 404
expected: 400 hoac 404. Khong 500. Prisma xac thuc ID format.

title: RED - upload chua co internet connection (offline) - FE error
expected: FE: network error. Error message: 'Loi ket noi. Kiem tra mang va thu lai.' Khong crash.

title: RED - download tren HTTPS nhung cert khong hop le - browser warn
steps: Download tren HTTPS voi cert issue.
expected: Browser hien warning. Khong auto-download. User phai confirm.

title: RED - upload chay khi trang dang navigate away - huy upload
preconditions: Upload dang chay. Navigate sang trang khac.
expected: Upload bi huy (AbortController hoac FE unmount cleanup). Khong zombie request. Neu file da len server: cleanup hoac tao doc bi dat flag.

title: RED - upload 3 files, ca 3 fail - form van mo, loi hien ro
expected: failed.length === filesToUpload.length → form khong dong. Error: '[file1]: loi. [file2]: loi. [file3]: loi.' Van hien.

title: RED - upload voi session bi revoke (server-side logout) - 401
expected: 401. Nhu session expire. Redirect login.

title: RED - file input 'accept' attribute bi bo qua boi user (bypass FE filter) - BE nhan
steps: HTML injection / DevTools xoa accept attr → chon .exe → submit.
expected: BE la tuyen bao ve cuoi cung. Magic byte check reject .exe. 400.

title: RED - tam dinh chi upload: ngan hang upload khi BE maintenance mode
expected: 503 Service Unavailable. Message: 'He thong dang bao tri, vui long thu lai sau.' Form hien loi.

title: RED - upload doc co file path chua null bytes (path injection) - BE reject
expected: BE: path.basename + strip null bytes. Reject hoac sanitize. Khong path injection.

title: RED - incident-type officer upload voi petitionId - 403
preconditions: Officer chi co quyen incident scope.
steps: Upload voi petitionId cua petition ngoai scope.
expected: assertPetitionParentInScope: 403.

title: RED - download voi Range header (partial content) - 200 hoac 206
expected: 206 Partial Content hoac 200 Full. Khong 416. Stream van dung. FE xu ly both.

title: RED - upload tren HTTPS (production) - file va request an toan
expected: TLS encryption. No mixed content. HSTS header. Request an toan tren dang truyen.

title: RED - FE upload form: sau thanh cong, title va docType reset
steps: Upload PDF. Xem state sau khi form dong.
expected: title='', docType='VAN_BAN', description='', queue=[]. Mo lai form: form sach.

title: RED - folder upload: hidden OS files (.DS_Store) duoc filter hoac rejected
expected: FE: filter file bat dau bang '.'. Hoac BE reject mime. .DS_Store khong duoc luu.

title: RED - nhan Tai len 2 lan nhanh (double click) - khong double-upload
expected: Button disabled ngay sau click dau. Chi 1 POST duoc gui. Khong co 2 doc trung nhau.

title: RED - fetch docs sau upload fail - list van hien docs cu
steps: Upload that bai. Xem danh sach docs.
expected: fetchDocs() KHONG duoc goi khi tat ca file fail. List hien docs cu (truoc khi fail). Khong load lai.

title: RED - upload voi Accept-Language header la la - server xu ly binh thuong
preconditions: Request voi Accept-Language: xx-XX (khong ton tai).
expected: Server ignore Accept-Language. Response binh thuong (201/400 tuy noi dung). Khong 500.

title: RED - upload khi session cookie bi stolen va dung tu IP khac - 401
steps: Upload voi stolen session tu IP khac.
expected: Server detect IP mismatch hoac cookie invalid. 401. Log suspicious.

title: RED - download voi forged token (another user ID but valid sig) - 403
preconditions: Token hop le nhung userId la nguoi khac.
steps: Download /documents/:id voi JWT cua user A nhung id cua doc cua user B.
expected: Scope check: user A khong co quyen. 403.

title: RED - upload voi incidentId la cuid hợp le nhung incident thuoc team khac - 403
steps: officer (team A) upload voi incidentId cua team B.
expected: assertParentInScope: 403.

title: RED - multipart boundary attack: boundary string la XSS payload
expected: multer/Express parse boundary literal. Khong execute. Log ghi nhan. 200/400 tuy content.

title: RED - upload PNG corrupt (broken header) - magic byte fail hoac multer reject
expected: file-type: unknown hoac corrupt → reject 400. Hoac multer accept nhung magic check fail.

title: RED - upload DOCX voi OLE exploit (malformed XML) - accept nhung khong execute
expected: Accept (magic byte ok). Khong execute. Server khong parse noi dung. Luu as binary blob.

title: RED - upload voi X-Forwarded-For spoofed IP - throttle by real IP
steps: POST voi X-Forwarded-For: 1.1.1.1 tu IP thuc 10.0.0.1.
expected: Throttle dung IP thuc (sau proxy). X-Forwarded-For khong bypass throttle. NestJS ThrottlerGuard lay IP dung.

title: RED - upload voi Content-Disposition attachment trong multipart - ignore
steps: Gui multipart voi Content-Disposition: attachment; filename='../../../etc/passwd'.
expected: multer lay filename an toan. path.basename strip ../. originalName = 'passwd'. Khong path traversal.

title: RED - upload khi disk space co 1 byte con (edge disk capacity) - fail gracefully
expected: ENOSPC. 500. Message an toan. file khong duoc tao. Cleanup bat ky temp file.

title: RED - download bi revoke giua chung stream - stream closed cleanly
steps: Admin revoke access giua chung download.
expected: Stream bi cat. 403 hoac partial 206. Khong server crash. Resource cleanup.

title: RED - tai len khi petition co flag 'archived' - 403 hoac 409
expected: 403 Forbidden hoac 409 Conflict. 'Don thu da bi luu tru, khong the tai them tai lieu.'

title: RED - FE: chon file > 10MB - hien error truoc khi upload (client-side check)
expected: FE kiem tra file.size > 10MB → hien error trong queue: 'bao_cao.pdf: File qua lon (toi da 10MB)'. KHONG post to server.

title: RED - multiple errors: 2 files fail voi 2 errors khac nhau
expected: failed = ['too-large.pdf: File qua lon', 'exe.pdf: Dinh dang khong hop le']. Ca 2 fail → error hien ro cac file va ly do. Form van mo.

title: RED - upload khi BE tra ve 503 (service unavailable) - FE retry suggestion
expected: FE error: 'Dich vu tam thoi khong kha dung. Vui long thu lai sau.' Form giu nguyen.

title: RED - FE: reset file input refs sau cancel (stale ref fix)
steps: 1. Chon file. 2. Cancel. 3. Tai len lai voi cung file.
expected: fileRef.current.value = '' sau cancel. File input reset. Co the chon lai cung file lan sau.

title: BOUNDARY - GET /documents?limit=0 - tra ve empty hoac default
expected: BE: limit=0 → tra ve default 50 hoac error 400. Khong tra ve all records.

preconditions: Da upload 7 files trong 60s. Con 3 slot.

expected: Ca 3 accept. 201 each. Throttle counter = 10.

title: BOUNDARY - GET /documents?skip=0&limit=1 - tra ve doc dau tien
expected: Tra ve 1 doc. Meta.total > 1. Pagination dung.

expected: Accept. 201. (Duoi 10MB limit).

expected: Tat ca 10 response < 5s. Stream song song. Khong block nhau. Server khong het thread.
